entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes. I bought some shoes and... I don't think they're right. I'm not sure what to do.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, um, yes, I think so. It's VF886-0125. It was for those road cycling shoes.
Perfect, thank you. I see the order here. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

I... I don't really know. I'm so confused. I tried to set up the cleats, but I'm not sure I did it right. And I went for one ride and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. The website made it all seem so easy.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I see here that the shoes were delivered 20 days ago.
Is that okay? I get so lost with all the different policies online. It's all a bit much. Can't you just help me? I think I just need a refund at this point.
Of course, I can absolutely help you with that, and please don't worry. You are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window for standard items. We can definitely cannot offer a refund for you.
Oh, really? That's a relief. So I just mail them back?

That's right. And I see here that you're a VIP member with us, so I've just gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. You can just print that out and attach it to the box.
Wow, that's... that's so much easier. Thank you so much, Charlie. I was really stressed about this.
It's my pleasure to help. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Will there be anything else for you today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
